name: Question 13
problem:

$$
{y}^{′}=8{y}^{2}-16(x+7)y+8(x+7)^{2}+1
$$

find the general solution of the equation.

Question 13
?

Given that y0(x)=x+7 is a particular solution of the Riccati differential equation

y′=8y2−16(x+7)y+8(x+7)2+1

find the general solution of the equation.

a
y=x+7−1x+C
b
y=x+7+28x−C
c
y=x+7−18x+C
d
y=x+7+18x+C
e
y=x+7+28x+C
